findings.location: “Ninajua!” alifikiria. “Hii itakuwa fursa nzuri kujaribu kukitaa kwa kisu kile Paul alinipa.”
findings.source_quote: “I know!” she thought to herself. “This would be a perfect time to try some whittling with that knife Paul gave me.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the verb 'whittling' with the common Kiswahili verb for carving/shaving wood. For example: “Ninajua!” alifikiria. “Hii itakuwa fursa nzuri kujaribu kuchonga kwa kisu kile Paul alinipa.”
findings.translation_quote: “Ninajua!” alifikiria. “Hii itakuwa fursa nzuri kujaribu kukitaa kwa kisu kile Paul alinipa.”

findings.location: Baada ya muda, tawi ambalo Ellie alikuwa amekaa lilianza kuhisi gumu na mabai, na matawi aliyekuwa akiyachonga karibu yalitoweka.
findings.source_quote: After a time, the branch Ellie was sitting on began to feel rough and hard, and the twigs she was whittling had nearly disappeared.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Mabai' is not an idiomatic rendering of 'rough' here. Use a clearer phrase such as “mabomu” or “kugea”/“kuungua” is wrong; better: “lilianza kuhisi gumu na kugura” or “lilianza kuonekana gumu na chungu” so the meaning 'rough and hard' is natural: “...lilianza kuonekana gumu na hukuwa laini.”
findings.translation_quote: Baada ya muda, tawi ambalo Ellie alikuwa amekaa lilianza kuhisi gumu na mabai, na matawi aliyekuwa akiyachonga karibu yalitoweka.

findings.location: Alibadilika hadi tawi la chini na kukaa amekaa tayari kuruka chini kama alivyokuwa akifanya kila mara kutoka kwenye mti.
findings.source_quote: She shifted to the lowest branch and sat poised, ready to jump down like she always did to get out of the tree.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Alibadilika' is ambiguous. Use 'Alibadilisha mkao mpaka tawi la chini' or 'Alihamia tawi la chini' and remove duplicated 'na kukaa amekaa'. Suggested: “Alihamia tawi la chini na kukaa tayari kuruka chini, kama alivyokuwa akifanya kila mara.”
findings.translation_quote: Alibadilika hadi tawi la chini na kukaa amekaa tayari kuruka chini kama alivyokuwa akifanya kila mara kutoka kwenye mti.

findings.location: Alishtuka, akiangalia kisu mkononi mwake. “Usiruke mahali popote ukiwa na kisu mkononi!” sauti ya mama yake ilimpita akilini.
findings.source_quote: She paused, looking at the knife in her hand. “Never jump down from anywhere while holding a knife in your hand!” her mother’s voice rang in her memory.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Alishtuka' implies she was startled. The source says she 'paused' (stopped) to look. Use 'Alisita' or 'Alisimamisha' to match the original: “Alisita, akiangalia kisu mkononi mwake.”
findings.translation_quote: Alishtuka, akiangalia kisu mkononi mwake. “Usiruke mahali popote ukiwa na kisu mkononi!” sauti ya mama yake ilimpita akilini.

findings.location: Kwa hatia, alibana kidole gumba juu ya kidonda na akajichomea ndani ya nyumba.
findings.source_quote: Guiltily, she quickly pressed her thumb on top of the wound and slipped into the house.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Akajichomea ndani ya nyumba' is incorrect and suggests she stabbed herself into the house. Use 'akaingia' for 'slipped into the house'. Suggested: “Kwa hatia, alibana kidole gumba juu ya kidonda na akalazimika kuingia ndani ya nyumba.” or simply “...kisha akaingia ndani ya nyumba.”
findings.translation_quote: Kwa hatia, alibana kidole gumba juu ya kidonda na akajichomea ndani ya nyumba.

findings.location: Wakati alipotua, kifundo cha mguu wake kiligeuka na kumkaba chini. Alianguka kwa njia isiyofaa kwenye mguu wake wa kushoto.
findings.source_quote: Just as she landed, her ankle turned and gave way under her. She fell awkwardly onto her left leg.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Kumkaba chini' is awkward. Better: 'kikaanguka' or 'kikamwacha' is unclear. Suggested: “Wakati alipotua, kifundo cha mguu wake kiligeuka na kumnyima mtego. Alianguka kwa njia isiyofaa juu ya mguu wake wa kushoto.” Or: “Wakati alipotua, kifundo cha mguu wake kiligeuka na kumfanya aporomoke kwa mguu wa kushoto.”
findings.translation_quote: Wakati alipotua, kifundo cha mguu wake kiligeuka na kumkaba chini. Alianguka kwa njia isiyofaa kwenye mguu wake wa kushoto.
